weak.desc: 同一個字反覆拼錯：choose 曾出現三種不同錯拼方式；跨篇重複出現的個人記憶點錯字：prasious(precious)、choise(choice)、achivement(achievement)、addvice/addvise
although...but 冗贅並用；In my concern/angle 代替 In my opinion；even though...but、Even I am not...but 再次出現（累計 4 次同型）

explain.rule: 這種錯誤是直接把中文的思考邏輯或搭配方式套進英文，英文母語者不會這樣講。要練習的不是文法，而是「換句話說」的能力——想到中文詞先問自己「英文母語者真的會這樣講嗎」，而不是逐字翻譯。
examples: ✗ In my concern / In my angle → ✓ In my opinion（依我看）
✗ although...but 同時使用 → ✓ 兩個連接詞只能擇一：Although X, Y. 或 X, but Y.

weak.desc: 如 team have、website appears、every words surround 等

explain.rule: 動詞要跟主詞的人稱、單複數一致。單數主詞（he/she/it/單一名詞）動詞加 -s；複數主詞或 I/you/we/they 動詞不加 -s。集合名詞（team, family）通常當單數看待。
examples: ✗ The team have a plan. → ✓ The team has a plan.
✗ Every word surround me. → ✓ Every word surrounds me.

weak.desc: You/Your/If/It/When/Life/The 等字在句中被誤大寫，已確認為系統性錯誤，非單一字詞問題；本篇 If、Even 各一次
敘事段落中過去式與現在式（含 will）混用

explain.rule: 描述過去發生的事，整段都要用過去式，不要中途切換回現在式或未來式（will）。可以先確認「這件事是不是已經發生過」，是的話全程用過去式。
examples: ✗ When I was young, I will fall asleep in class. → ✓ ...I would fall asleep in class.
✗ He come back and everyone didn't complain. → ✓ He came back...

weak.desc: 如 everyone effort to do something，已確認為穩定重複錯誤

explain.rule: effort 是名詞（努力，一份心力），不是動詞。「努力做某事」要用 make an effort to V 或直接用動詞 try / work hard。
examples: ✗ Everyone effort to run. → ✓ Everyone makes an effort to run.
✗ I effort to learn English. → ✓ I try hard to learn English.

weak.desc: efficient/effective、progress/process、contract/contrast、interesting/interest、exciting/stimulate 當名詞用；incredible/incredulous（選錯字導致情緒意思說反，非拼字問題）

words.note: effect 是名詞「影響、效果」；affect 才是動詞「影響」。08/09 兩次、08/23 一次
合約/收縮 vs. 對比
進展 vs. 過程；07/12、07/26 各一次
令人驚嘆的 vs. 不敢置信的（意思幾乎相反）

explain.rule: 這類錯誤選錯的是「字」不是「形式」，所以拼字檢查抓不到，句子文法也是通的，只有意思悄悄跑掉。最危險的是 incredible／incredulous 這種——意思幾乎相反，讀者會完全誤解。
examples: ✗ These pravious habit always effect my study efficient
✓ These previous habits always affect my study efficiency（affect 才是動詞）
✓ The comments had a strong effect on my choice.（effect 是名詞，常搭 have an effect on）
✗ The picture presents a sharp contract between left and right
✓ The picture presents a sharp contrast between left and right
✗ I feel incredible because I couldn't believe he would betray me
✓ I felt incredulous because I couldn't believe he would betray me（incredible 是「了不起的」，意思相反）

weak.desc: 客觀描述段落誤植主觀意見；2026-09-06 為更嚴重的變體：圖片描述段完全未描述圖片，改用「如果你走進寵物友善餐廳會看到…」的假設通則替代。場景判讀（寵物友善餐廳）本身合理且題目允許，問題在於未從圖中具體人事物推得該判讀

explain.rule: 題目通常要求「先客觀描述，再給個人意見」分兩段處理。寫客觀描述段落時，先問自己：這句話是在講圖表/情境本身的內容，還是已經在講「我」的想法？如果太早出現 I think / In my opinion，代表跳段了。
examples: 客觀段落應該像：The chart shows that 76.9% of students spend money on making friends.（描述數據）
而不是一開始就寫：I think making friends is important to me.（提早進入主觀意見）

weak.desc: 所有格 its 與縮寫 it's 混用

explain.rule: its（無撇號）是所有格，「它的」；it's（有撇號）是 it is 或 it has 的縮寫。判斷方法：把 it's 展開成 it is，唸起來通順就是 it's，不通順就是 its。
examples: ✗ its delivery fee is cheap and it's cheap → 應為：its delivery fee is cheap
✓ It's raining today.（It is raining）
✓ The dog wagged its tail.（牠的尾巴）

weak.desc: 多個獨立子句以逗號直接連接，未使用句號或連接詞（如 When I go to a restaurant I just want to eat..., I don't have any patience...）

explain.rule: 兩個各自能獨立成句的子句，不能只用逗號連接（這叫 comma splice）。要嘛用句號分開、用分號、或加連接詞（and, but, because, so...）。
examples: ✗ It was raining, we stayed home. → ✓ It was raining, so we stayed home. / It was raining. We stayed home.
✗ I like it, it is cheap. → ✓ I like it because it is cheap.

weak.cat: worth to V 結構錯誤
weak.desc: 應為 worth + V-ing，如 worth to afford 應為 worth enduring

explain.rule: worth 後面接動詞時，要用動名詞（V-ing），不能用 to V。「值得做某事」= worth V-ing。
examples: ✗ It is worth to try. → ✓ It is worth trying.
✗ worth to afford → ✓ worth enduring

weak.desc: 如 chat to（應為with）、interest to（應為in）、fit to（應為for）、impression to（應為on）、on a restaurant（應為 in/at）

explain.rule: 介係詞沒有邏輯可推，只能連同動詞或名詞一起記。這些錯誤幾乎都是把中文的方位或對象概念直譯過來（「對某人的印象」→ impression to），要練的是把「動詞＋介係詞」當成一個單位背下來。

words.wrong: shoot a vlog to my daily life

examples: ✗ It will hard to chat to others
✓ It will be hard to chat with others
✗ Make up can give strangers a good impression to other
✓ Makeup can give others a good impression of you
✗ merry-go-around is fit to young people
✓ a merry-go-round is suitable for young children
✗ as a someone that fear to height
✓ as someone who is afraid of heights
✗ Until I graduade in senior high school
✓ Until I graduated from senior high school

weak.desc: 如 I still be present、it will hard to、is prepare 等

explain.rule: 當句子的動詞是「形容詞」或「Ving/p.p.」時，前面一定要有 be 動詞（am/is/are/was/were）撐住句子，不能省略。
examples: ✗ I still be present. → ✓ I am still present.
✗ It will hard to chat. → ✓ It will be hard to chat.

weak.desc: motivate/motive、considering/consideration、efficient/efficiency 等；tolerant/tolerance

explain.rule: 這個字的意思是對的，但拿了錯的詞性去用。最集中的是「形容詞當名詞」（exciting、pleasant、thrilling 當名詞）和「名詞當動詞或形容詞」（choice 當動詞、harmony 當形容詞）。背單字時要連詞性一起背，尤其 -ing 結尾的字幾乎都是形容詞，不能直接當名詞用。
examples: 【核心規則：-ing 結尾多半是形容詞，不能直接當名詞用】
✗ it lack exciting and stimulate
✓ it lacks excitement and stimulation
✗ These place can provide thrilling and pleasment
✓ These places can provide thrills and pleasure
✗ playing games can acquire pleasant
✓ playing games can bring pleasure
✗ It can effectively increase efficient
✓ It can effectively increase efficiency
✗ you can choice campsite A
✓ you can choose campsite A

weak.cat: 關係子句多餘主詞代名詞
weak.desc: 如 that it seem、that it use、which...it，跨三篇出現，2026/08 正式確認

explain.rule: 用 that / which / who 開頭的關係子句，句子裡已經包含了主詞的角色，後面不能再重複加一個 it / he 等代名詞。
examples: ✗ Yawoo that it use no-contact service → ✓ Yawoo, which uses no-contact service
✗ the theme, which people will like it → ✓ the theme, which people will like

weak.desc: most X 應為 X-est，如 most clear 應為 clearest、most easy 應為 easiest

explain.rule: 形容詞最高級的判斷依「音節數」：1-2 音節的字，字尾直接加 -est；3 音節（含）以上的字，前面加 most，不能加 -est。
examples: 1音節：clear → clearest（不是 most clear）
2音節：easy → easiest（不是 most easy）
3音節以上：beautiful → most beautiful；important → most important

weak.desc: 如 to get and keeping、cutting and decide

explain.rule: 當兩個動詞用 and 連接、共用同一個結構時，前後的動詞形式要一致（都是 to V，或都是 V-ing），不能一個 to V 一個 V-ing。
examples: ✗ to get new friends and keeping the friendship → ✓ to get new friends and keep the friendship
✗ cutting video and decide the theme → ✓ cutting video and deciding the theme

weak.desc: As me recall 應為 As I；make my 應為 make me

explain.rule: 代名詞在句子中當主詞要用主格（I, he, she），當受詞或介係詞後面要用受格（me, him, her）。
examples: ✗ As me recall → ✓ As I recall
✗ It will make my not-alone → ✓ It will make me feel not alone

weak.desc: 如 many food 應為 much food

explain.rule: 不可數名詞（如 food, money, advice）前面不能用 many，要用 much 或 a lot of；也不能加 s 變複數。
examples: ✗ many food → ✓ much food / a lot of food
✗ many advices → ✓ much advice / some advice

weak.cat: 冠詞誤加（抽象/泛指名詞）
weak.desc: the friendship、the nature 等抽象或泛指名詞前誤加 the

explain.rule: 當抽象名詞（friendship, nature, happiness）是泛指、不特定某一個時，前面不加 the。只有在特指「某一種、某一次」的狀況才加 the。
examples: ✗ the friendship is important → ✓ friendship is important（泛指友情這個概念）
✗ trust the nature → ✓ trust nature

weak.desc: 與句中誤大寫並存出現，顯示大小寫規則尚未真正掌握，而非單純粗心
以 measure 代替「設施/活動」一詞，非拼字問題，需口頭直接教正確說法；pet-setting（疑為 pet seating / pet-sitting）、discrease negative review to people 語意不成立

explain.rule: 選了一個真實存在、拼寫正確的英文字，但那個字的意思不是要表達的意思。拼字檢查抓不到，文法也通，閱卷者只會覺得「這句在講什麼」。特別注意 measure 和 viewpoint 這兩個——已形成穩定的自創對應（measure＝遊樂設施、viewpoint＝景點），各出現多次，需要直接口頭給正確字。

words.note: 08/09，固定用來指「景點」；viewpoint 是觀點或觀景台
08/02，photography 是攝影這門技藝，不是相機

words.wrong: used to check（指現在的習慣）
words.note: 08/09，used to V 是過去的習慣

examples: ✗ there are many amusement measure like roller coaster
✓ there are many amusement rides, such as roller coasters
✗ I'm sick of being a photographer when my friends go to play amusements measure
✓ I'm tired of being the photographer while my friends go on the rides
✗ These comments will effect cosumers to choice viewpoint or restaurant
✓ These comments affect how consumers choose an attraction or a restaurant
✗ the man is introducing the food under the photography
✓ the man is introducing the food in front of the camera
✗ It will be worth to afford troll's comment
✓ It will be worth putting up with trolls' comments

weak.desc: slap on my face 應為 slap myself；force me 應為 force myself（新觀察，尚待再次確認）；themself 應為 themselves（形式錯誤）

explain.rule: 當動作的對象就是自己時，要用反身代名詞（myself, yourself, himself...），不能只用一般代名詞或介係詞代替。
examples: ✗ slap on my face → ✓ slap myself in the face
✗ force me to stay awake → ✓ force myself to stay awake

weak.desc: 多篇皆有結構打結、無法確定原意的句子，依標準不猜測，列出待老師詢問學生

explain.rule: 這類句子不是單一文法點的問題，而是整句邏輯、指涉對象或想表達的意思本身不清楚。這種情況建議直接口頭問學生「這句你原本想講什麼」，不要用猜的去改，避免曲解原意。
examples: 例如「the peer glance to what when you go to get second round」——結構跟邏輯都需要學生親自澄清才能準確修正

weak.desc: than 與 then 混用，同一篇出現兩次（Back than 應為 Back then；We haven't been touch since than 應為 since then）

explain.rule: than 用在「比較」（than 前後常有比較級形容詞，如 more...than, better than）；then 用在「時間先後」（然後、當時）。唸出來發音不同，但因為長得像常打錯。
examples: ✓ Back then, I thought nothing could tear us apart.（那時候）
✓ He is taller than me.（比…更高）

weak.desc: 指稱對象前後不一致，如 breaking off his friendship 應為 our friendship（這段友情是雙方的，不是單方的）；同篇也出現 my best friends 與全文單一朋友的敘事對象數量不一致

explain.rule: 代名詞（his/her/their/our...）要跟它所指的對象一致。寫之前先確認：這件事情/這段關係是屬於誰的？是單方的還是雙方共有的？
examples: ✗ breaking off his friendship（這段友情是雙方的） → ✓ breaking off our friendship
確認全文的敘事對象是單數還是複數，代名詞要跟著一致

weak.desc: 可數名詞的單複數形式錯誤，遺漏與誤加都有：many accident、Every words、one of my biggest regret（該複數卻單數）；peoples、manys、others people、Social medias、On the other hands（不該複數卻加 s）

explain.rule: 兩個方向的錯誤同時存在，代表問題不是「忘記加 s」，而是下筆時沒有判斷這個名詞此刻是幾個。規則本身很簡單：可數名詞不是一個就加 s；many/those/several/one of 後面一定複數；people 本身已是複數不再加 s。難的是養成每寫一個名詞就順手判斷數量的習慣。
examples: ✗ many accident → ✓ many accidents
✗ one of my biggest regret → ✓ one of my biggest regrets
✗ arrange right peoples → ✓ arrange the right people（people 已是複數）
✗ On the other hands → ✓ On the other hand

weak.cat: 動詞形式錯誤（助動詞／不定詞後）
weak.desc: 助動詞或 to 後面沒有接原形：will been（×2）、to got a progress、to having transform、would listened、was lay on the bed、when was fall in love

explain.rule: will/can/would 等助動詞後面、以及 to 後面，一律接動詞原形，沒有例外。been 只能跟在 have/has/had 之後。這類錯誤多半發生在想表達比較複雜的時態時，越用力越容易亂。
examples: ✗ that will been a disaster → ✓ that will be a disaster
✗ It's a good way to got a progress → ✓ ...to get through the process
✗ I would patiently listened → ✓ I would patiently listen
✗ when I was lay on the bed → ✓ when I was lying on the bed

weak.cat: 冠詞遺漏（單數可數名詞）
weak.desc: 單數可數名詞前少了 a/an/the：I am not pets hater、go to the restaurant（泛指應為 a restaurant）、see the sight like this picture

explain.rule: 單數可數名詞前面「一定」要有限定詞（a/an/the/my/this…），沒有例外。泛指某一類事物時用 a/an，不是零冠詞。這點與先前的「冠詞誤加」剛好相反，代表冠詞系統整體尚未建立。
examples: ✗ I am not pets hater → ✓ I am not a pet hater
✗ When I go to the restaurant（泛指任何一家）→ ✓ When I go to a restaurant

weak.cat: 附屬子句片段（主要子句遺漏）
weak.desc: 以 If / Because / Even though 等附屬連接詞開頭的子句被當成完整句子、後面直接句號，主要子句遺漏或被切到下一句。跨三篇出現：7/26「If your team have peoples who is lazy...」、8/30「Even though it can't come ture.」、9/06「But if the restaurant can set a space...」與「Because it can effectively attract...」

explain.rule: 與 run-on 方向相反：run-on 是「該斷不斷」，這個是「不該斷卻斷」。成因是中文的「如果…」「因為…」「雖然…」單獨講出來可以自成一句（例：「因為它可以吸引愛動物的人啊」），英文不行——附屬子句永遠只是半句，必須與主要子句同處一個句子內。建議機械式練習：給 10 個 If／Because／Even though 開頭的半句，只要求補完後半。
examples: ✗ But if the restaurant can set aside a space. I think that will be a win-win solution.
✓ But if the restaurant can set aside a space, I think that will be a win-win solution.
✗ Because it can effectively attract people who like animals.
✓ ..., because it can effectively attract people who like animals.

weak.desc: 動詞後面接錯結構，非單字選錯而是句型記錯：disrupt us to find（應為 prevent us from finding）、let us to save、cause...must handle、make happy to others、spend 100$ geting、be used to getting 與 used to get 混用

explain.rule: 成因不是不認識這個動詞，而是「知道意思、不知道它後面要接什麼」。英文每個動詞的後接結構是固定的，必須連同結構一起背，不能只背中文意思——prevent 的中文是「阻止」，但不能說 prevent sb to V，只能說 prevent sb from V-ing。這比拼字更該優先處理：拼錯字閱卷者看得懂，句型錯了句子會直接讀不通。

words.correct: like a YouTuber, I would explore
be used to V-ing ≠ used to V
make others happy（make ＋ 受詞 ＋ 形容詞）

words.wrong: spend my time to having transform

examples: 【背動詞時連句型一起背，不要只背中文意思】
✗ This behavior will disrupt us to find worthwhile spots
✓ This behavior prevents us from finding worthwhile spots
✗ The adult will always let us to save money
✓ Adults always let us save money（let ＋ 受詞 ＋ 原形）
✗ It will cause others teamate must handle their work
✓ It will cause other teammates to handle their work（cause ＋ 受詞 ＋ to V）
✗ If my video can make happy to others
✓ If my video can make others happy（make ＋ 受詞 ＋ 形容詞）
✗ spend 100$ geting the delivery fee free
✓ spend $100 on getting free delivery（spend ＋ 錢 ＋ on V-ing）

portfolio.title: 食物外送平台比較（UBirds / Yawoo / Foodbear）
portfolio.prompt: 依表格描述三個食物外送平台特色，並說明自己是否會使用、會選哪個平臺及原因。
portfolio.original:
After the Covid 19 trend, more and more food delivery services website appears like a gress. In these picture, these website are using own wan to survice in delivery war. For example, the UBird's feture is they have wide goods and spend 100$ geting the delivery fee free these two ways can attract students or others people who don't have much budget. portfolio.corrected:
After the Covid-19 trend, more and more food delivery service websites have appeared like grass. In this picture, these websites are using their own way to survive in the delivery war. For example, UBird's feature is that they have a wide range of goods and offer free delivery when you spend $100 — these two ways can attract students or other people who don't have much budget. Another is Yawoo, which uses no-contact delivery and offers free delivery during specific hours. I think the no-contact service can be an attractive way to appeal to people who easily feel shy in communication, but the specific-hour free delivery is not the best way to draw people who will become regular visitors, even though its delivery fee only costs $24. The last one is Foodbear, which has the clearest intention of targeting high-spending customers. Foodbear collaborates with high-end restaurants, and its delivery fee is the most expensive among these three delivery websites.
For me, I won't use food delivery websites because I enjoy exploring the streets to find new restaurants. In this process, although I will be disappointed by some dishes that don't taste good, 〔語意待確認：I am still present when I find treasure restaurants〕. It is a sense of achievement, like a pirate finding treasure. However, if I want to be a couch potato, I will use food delivery services, and I will choose UBirds because I am not a rich man.

portfolio.note: 字彙難度是這批以來最高的一次（inevitably evolve into、endure、effectively、scattered drool 皆為主動選用的高階詞），但外殼與內部零件落差極大。內容失分集中在第一段：題目問「你認為圖中呈現的是什麼景象」，期待「先描述圖中人事物→再推得判讀」，這篇寫成「先宣告寵物友善餐廳很普遍→走進去會看到這種畫面」，方向相反，圖中抱狗的女子、桌上餐點、椅子上的貓、拿平板的男子全數缺席。（判讀成寵物友善餐廳本身合理，題目用「某餐廳」且直接問「你認為」，屬開放判讀，不構成扣分。）第二段立場明確（顧客立場）並提出「設寵物專區」的解法，與第一段形成一般餐廳／友善餐廳的對照推進，是全篇最有價值的部分，但被 But／Because 開頭的片段句切斷。文法舊病復發：although／even though...but 冗贅兩次、句中 If／Even 大寫、主詞動詞一致性三處、現在式敘述中混入 happened／didn't。新觀察三類：will been 兩次、複數 -s 遺漏四處、單數可數名詞冠詞遺漏三處。另有所有格撇號遺漏（pets noise → pets' noise），單次出現，先口頭提醒不另立類別。評分落在 8～9 邊界，因文法句構錯誤密度取 8。

portfolio.corrected:
Nowadays, using electronic devices has become a common phenomenon. Most people are used to checking comments on digital apps such as Google and IG. These comments easily affect how consumers choose an attraction or a restaurant. This phenomenon introduces more and more famous restaurants and interesting attractions to us, giving us a reference when we feel like going on outdoor adventures. What is more, these comments can promote must-visit spots for us. In addition, they can be a good tool for avoiding spots that trap tourists. Nevertheless, their disadvantages are also visible. Malicious comments can destroy many stores, and many operators are bothered by this. Besides, some spots buy comments, which helps them build a good reputation on social media, and this behavior prevents us from finding worthwhile spots.
From what I remember, I seldom refer to comments when I decide to go on an outdoor adventure. From my perspective, these comments are subjective, and I don't want these subjective opinions to affect my choice. Every attraction has something worthwhile for me, even though it may have a one-star rating. Like a famous YouTuber, "Coo," I would still like to explore the worst places, which have been rated one star on the Internet. I think it will become an unforgettable memory for me, one that proves how real online reviews are.
portfolio.note:
（本篇由老師自行逐句批改，此處僅記錄整體觀察與統計。）第一段的優缺點鋪陳是這批以來組織最好的一段：先講優點（推薦名店、避開陷阱），再用 Nevertheless 轉到缺點（惡意評論、買評論），轉折詞使用正確且分工清楚。第二段是失分處：題目明確要求「舉自己或親友的經驗為例」，舉的卻是一位 YouTuber，既非自己也非親友，屬於未完整回應題目要求；且第二段長度明顯不足，例子只有一句帶過。
語言層面錯誤密度極高（約 230 字內 42 處）。最突出的是單複數，單篇 9 處（3C product、Every people、digital app、viewpoint、must-visit spot、tourist、operater、opinion、Every viewpoints），是全數據中單篇最高。句中不當大寫 6 處（Using／These ×2／It／It's／This）也是單篇最高。
本篇首度確立「動詞句型／搭配錯誤」為獨立弱點：disrupt us to find（應為 prevent us from finding）、bother this event、like a YouTuber to explore，單篇 3 處。
另注意「I have only scratched the surface」一句語意突兀，在此處無法成立（該慣用語意為「我只談到皮毛」，與上下文不接），修正稿改為 What is more。此句宜口頭確認原本想表達什麼。
